title: ASP.NET Core MCP Server with Per-Session Tool Filtering
excerpt: ASP.NET Core MCP Server with Per Session Tool Filtering This sample demonstrates how to create an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that provides different sets of tools based on route based session configuration. This showcases the technique of using ConfigureSessionOptions to dynamically modify the ToolCollection based on route parameters for each MCP session.
